title: Event forwarding adapters
goal: Deliver raw events through injected services with observer ordering
scopes: Raw event forwarding through Transformer and Observer
approach: Handle calls Started for a non-nil observer, delegates the original input to Transformer.Transform exactly once, calls Finished with the original result only on success, and returns the original result and error unchanged.
explicit_rules: Do not trim, uppercase, coerce, retry, recover panics, or replace values
Started precedes Transform for a non-nil observer
Finished is called only when Transform returns no error
Return both original result and original error even on failure
constraints: Delegate raw values exactly once; do not normalize or coerce
Observer started before service; finished only on success
required_verification: Service substitution, error identity, and observer ordering tests
